Subject: Technical notes: SDK routes, streaming behavior, and quick integration checklist

Hi Taylor — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff with the exact routes and a short checklist so your infra team can open the right ports. Posting here so the thread stays in one place.

API / SDK summary (current hosted API):
- REST generation (non-stream): POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
  - payload: { model, input, max_tokens, temperature }
- Streaming (recommended for low-latency multi-token responses): POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/stream
  - behavior: server-sent events (SSE) chunked tokens; connection keeps KV cache per-session header x-rw-session-id
- Chat-style tool-calls: POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/call-tool
  - use when you need structured tool invocation; returns tool invocation token and follow-up prompt slot

SDKs:
- Node: npm i @redwood/inference (v0.9.x) — example streaming snippet in shared Drive doc
- Python: pip install redwood-inference (>=0.9.2) — use StreamingClient(stream=True)

Integration checklist (short):
- [ ] Whitelist outbound egress to api.redwood.com (443) and allow SSE to api.redwood.com/v1/generate/stream
- [ ] Provide S3 prefix & IAM role or signed URLs for sample data (s3://parcelwave-poc/sample-v1)
- [ ] Decide on logging: enable default request logs vs redact PII (we can set retention to 7 days for POC)
- [ ] Share performance sample dataset and expected traffic profile (concurrency, peak RPS)
- [ ] Schedule kickoff (Aug 1, 10am PT) and share calendar invites

Links:
- Integration checklist & snippets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC-ParcelWave
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

I'll upload a short integration-checklist.md to the shared folder; attaching a stub here as well.

See you on Friday.

— Stephanie
